info.title: codai — AI code assistant that works from the full context of your project.
info.description: Run Codai from anywhere with `dotnet tool install --global Codai`, or grab a self-contained build from the releases page.

options.name: --cwd
options.description: Project working directory (host directory unchanged).

options.name: --config
options.description: Configuration file (.codai.yml|yaml|json).

options.name: --provider
options.description: Chat provider: openai, azure-openai, anthropic, gemini, ollama, deepseek, openrouter, qwen, mistral, grok.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Provider endpoint override.

options.name: --model
options.description: Model identifier (provider default applies when omitted).

options.name: --temperature
options.description: Sampling temperature, 0 to 2.

options.name: --reasoning-effort
options.description: Reasoning effort: low | medium | high.

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

options.name: --retries
options.description: Stop after n consecutive tool failures (default: 3).

options.name: --stream
options.description: Stream the response (default: true).

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key (prefer the API_KEY environment variable).

options.name: --api-version
options.description: Version header for providers that need one (Anthropic).

options.name: --mode
options.description: How much the assistant may do: plan | agent (default: agent).

options.name: --no-shell
options.description: Do not offer the model a way to run commands.

options.name: --disable-tool
options.description: Hide and block a named tool for this run; repeatable.

options.name: --no-auto-compact
options.description: Never summarise a conversation that grows too long.

options.name: --compaction
options.description: Automatic compaction: agentic | basic | off (default: agentic).

options.name: --no-sub-agents
options.description: Do not let the model delegate a search to a sub-agent.

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Auto approve (interactive: true; headless: false).

options.name: --trust-directory
options.description: Authorize workspace access for this run (required headless).

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Run-wide timeout, including stdin and tools (0 disables).

options.name: --system
options.description: Replace default template; mode/tool policies remain enforced.

options.name: --json
options.description: JSON Lines events and final result for one-shot/piped tasks.

options.name: --acp
options.description: Start the host-neutral ACP compatibility JSON-lines adapter.

options.name: --data-dir
options.description: Isolated conversation/task/transcript state directory.

options.name: --config-dir
options.description: Configuration discovery directory (project root unchanged).

options.name: --hooks-dir
options.description: Additional hooks.json directory; commands require consent.

options.name: --no-hooks
options.description: Disable global, project, and injected lifecycle hooks.

options.name: --continue
options.description: Resume the conversation stored for this project.

options.name: --execute-plan
options.description: Execute latest completed Plan after consent; prompt/stdin adds instructions.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the version and exit.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this help and exit.
Flags also accept the legacy snake_case spelling (for example --base_url).
Use -- before literal prompt text that starts with a dash.
One-shot/piped tasks deny writes and commands unless --auto-approve true; no approval input is read.
Exit codes: 0 request completed, 1 error, 124 timeout, 130 cancelled. Completion does not mean edits were applied.
